methodologyNotes: Roster covers 13 external and chamber food vacuum sealers. Two requested SKUs do not exist and were substituted with notes: 'Wevac CV6' (Wevac's chamber lineup is CV10 / CV12 / CV12 Turbo only -> CV10 substituted) and 'Potane VS5520' (Potane's active Precision Pro SKU is VS5736 -> substituted). All prices and headline specs independently re-verified June 2026 against manufacturer pages (anovaculinary.com, nesco.com, avidarmor.com, inkbird.com, potane.com, wevactech.com, foodsaver.com) and reputable retailers/reviews. Corrections applied this pass: FoodSaver VS3150 pulse_function false->true (FoodSaver lists a pulse setting) and accessory_port true->null (model uses a retractable handheld sealer, no confirmed hose port); FoodSaver FM2000 built_in_cutter and bag_roll_storage null->false (the FM2100 ADDS these over the FM2000 per FoodSaver, so FM2000 lacks both); Wevac CV10 accessory_port false->null (manufacturer states an external-vacuum accessory hose/port exists, an independent review says it lacks one - disputed); Bonsenkitchen VS3802 and Mueller MV-1100 priceUsd set to null (no current published US retail price verifiable; both now sell mainly on secondary market); Potane VS5736 priceNote corrected ($179.99 MSRP, $149.99 current, not $149.99 MSRP). seal_width_in = max compatible bag width in inches unless an exact sealing-bar dimension was stated. boolean true = feature present; null = could not corroborate. priceUsd = lowest verified US MSRP or typical current retail. accessedAt 2026-06-19.

products.name: FoodSaver VS3150 Multi-Use Vacuum Sealing System
products.priceNote: Current retail $214 at Walmart; MSRP not separately published
products.provenance: Price $214 confirmed via Walmart listing. FoodSaver's own feature copy for the VS3150 lists pulse, marinate, moist and dry settings plus roll storage with a built-in cutter bar (dry/moist true, cutter true, roll storage true, pulse true - an earlier version's pulse function:false was WRONG). Accessory_port left blank: the multi-use design uses a retractable handheld sealer rather than a confirmed hose/canister port. Exact seal-bar width not published by FoodSaver.

products.name: FoodSaver FM2000 Vacuum Sealing System
products.provenance: Price $79.97 confirmed at Home Depot. Dry-only (no Moist mode) confirmed. built in cutter and bag roll storage corrected null->false: FoodSaver/retailer comparisons state the FM2100 ADDS integrated roll storage and a cutter bar over the FM2000, so the FM2000 lacks both. Accessory port (hose) included/confirmed. Seal-bar width not published. Comes with an 11in x 10ft roll and accessory hose.

products.name: Anova Precision Chamber Vacuum Sealer
products.priceNote: $374.00 USD regular price at Popover Kitchen Supply (US retailer, formerly Zest Billings) for SKU ANCV01-US00, listed as sold out. Manufacturer site geo-redirected to the EU store (en-de, €329,00), so US MSRP was not directly confirmable, and the Amazon listing (B0BTPY59TG) showed no US buy price (geo-locked).
products.provenance: Re-verified on 2026-07-10. Manufacturer page (anovaculinary.com, geo-redirected to the en-de EU store showing €329,00) confirmed this is a chamber vacuum sealer with a "300mm | 11.8 in" seal bar, a "12 x 8.6 x 3 in" chamber, a 280W no-maintenance dry pump and 2-year warranty, with preset modes (infuse/extract, compress/pickle, dry/cool) plus manual vacuum/seal control; it seals liquids natively and uses pre-made pouches, explicitly contrasted against edge-sealer bags. No US price came from that page (EUR only). Popover Kitchen Supply (US retailer, formerly Zest), the corroboration, listed SKU ANCV01-US00 at a $374.00 USD regular price (sold out) — the source for the price — with identical chamber-sealer copy confirming the exact model (not the Vacuum Sealer Pro / Vacuum Sealer / Precision Port siblings). type and seal width (in) verified verbatim against the manufacturer spec table. built in cutter and bag roll storage kept false per the explicitly described pouch-based chamber design (no bag roll to store or cut). pulse function removed on re-verification: no pulse control is stated in either source (page describes preset modes and manual vacuum/seal-strength control only). modes dry moist and accessory port stay blank (no edge-sealer dry/moist toggle or accessory hose stated for this chamber model). The Amazon listing referenced for Model Number/dimensions was not re-fetched here and is not relied on for any published spec value.

products.name: Geryon E2900-MS Vacuum Sealer
products.priceNote: $41.99 on the Geryon manufacturer store (geryonkitchen.com), SILVER / US 110V variant, SKU E2900S-US. The Amazon retailer listing (Model E2900-MS, ASIN B07B4W5PMB) showed "No featured offers available" (no price displayed).
products.provenance: The Geryon manufacturer store page (geryonkitchen.com) lists the E2900-MS with a Specification block and confirms it is a compact external heat-seal/vacuum unit that "Fits up to 12'' width" bags and rolls, has "Two Sealing Modes" with a Moist/Dry seal-level setting (per the on-page FAQ), and ships with "1 x Air suction hose" plus a "Vacuum sealed jar or wine stopper" feature (accessory port). It is priced at $41.99 (SILVER / US 110V, SKU E2900S-US). The Amazon retailer listing states "Model Number E2900-MS" (ASIN B07B4W5PMB) and corroborates the same 12" max bag width, "Dry & Moist Modes", and an accessory hose/port (reviewers describe a "hose attachment port" for canisters); Amazon displayed no featured-offer price. A built-in cutter, bag-roll storage, and a pulse function are not stated for the E2900-MS on either page, so those are left blank (a separate Geryon SKU adds a built-in cutter).
